title: Agreement - Oakland Unified School District and the Building & Construction Trades Council of Alameda County - 2021-2022 Fiscal Year (Final Adoption)
official_text: Final Approval by the Board of Education of the Tentative Agreement, As Agreement Between the District and the Buildings & Construction Trades Council of Alameda County, Fiscal Year 2021-2022, with ACOE’s Letter to OUSD Regarding Recent Public Disclosure of Collective Bargaining Agreements (April 7, 2022) and AB 1200 Public Disclosure  and Certification of Cost (March 24, 2022).
headline: Final approval of the 2021-22 labor agreement with the Alameda County Building & Construction Trades Council
summary: The Board gives final approval to a tentative agreement between the district and the Building & Construction Trades Council of Alameda County for the 2021-22 fiscal year. The item includes the county office of education's letter on public disclosure of labor agreements and the district's public disclosure and certification of cost, but the text states no dollar amount.
vendor_name: Building & Construction Trades Council of Alameda County
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Compensation Increase - One Time Off Schedule Payments and Salary Schedule Adjustments - Unrepresented Substitue/Hourly Employees, Confidential Employees and Employees With Employment Contract
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2122-0224 - One Time Off Schedule Payments And Salary Schedule Adjustments Effective July 1, 2022 For Unrepresented Substitute/Hourly Employees, Confidential Employees, And Employees With Employment Contract.
headline: Adopts one-time off-schedule payments and salary adjustments for some unrepresented employees
summary: The Board adopts a resolution approving one-time payments outside the regular salary schedule, plus salary schedule adjustments, effective July 1, 2022. It covers unrepresented substitute and hourly employees, confidential employees, and employees with employment contracts. The text states no dollar amounts.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
